newsitem.title: USA: KN Energy plans Denver area pipeline.
newsitem.headline: KN Energy plans Denver area pipeline.

text.p: KN Wattenberg Transmission LLC, a KN Energy Inc subsidiary, said it plans to construct a natural gas pipeline that will help diversify supply and offer more competitive prices and services for consumers in the Denver metropolitan area and Front Range of Colorado.

The proposed Front Runner Pipeline would stretch 100 miles from the Rockport Hub, a confluence of several pipelines south of Cheyenne, Wyo., to access additional natural gas supply directly north of Denver near the Wyoming border to just north of Denver International Airport.
KN said it expects the pipeline to be in service for the late 1998-1999 heating season, carrying up to 250 million cubic feet of natural gas per day.

KN Wattenberg said its open season for firm capacity on the pipeline began Tuesday and will run through the end of August. KN Energy said the subsidiary will file for approval of the project with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission later this month.

KN said its Pony Express Pipeline, which will begin operations later this month, complements Front Runner by providing an outlet for excess natural gas supply to be transported from the Denver-Julesburg Basin to mid-continent markets.
